steps.body: {"persona": "sm", "prompt": "Review the prior notes/decisions for this task: ${taskHint}\n\nProduce a review_previous_notes report in markdown with a '## Premises' heading. Under it, list each load-bearing claim you are relying on as a bullet. Every bullet MUST end with EITHER a citation (a file:line reference, a run/PR/commit/issue id, or backtick command output) OR an explicit REFUTED or UNVERIFIED marker if you cannot ground it. Never leave a claim with neither.", "json_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"notes_md": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["notes_md"]}, "rubric": "premise_grounded", "model": "haiku", "max_budget_usd": 0.5, "max_turns": 4, "task_id": "${taskId}"}
